description: Frozen assistant-reviewed stroke references for 228 original source crops. Annotation and work-level development/confirmation split fixed before predictions. RGB maximum-channel error 25; absent estimates fail outlined cases; non-null estimates fail no-outline cases. Clearly visible primary outlines (including hollow and double-outline lettering) are scored; seven indistinct/illegible/continuous-glow cases retained unscored. Not human gold and not corpus-wide accuracy.
